decisions.reason: Focus unit has 次下蔡; 下蔡 is Xiacai. Xiaxia is an unattested mistranscription of the same characters, and the proposed swap corrects only the place name.
The Chinese is 次下蔡; Xiacai is the standard reading of 下蔡, while Xiaxia is a transcription error. The replacement restores the correct place without other changes.

Focus unit has 其弟偽齊王達: 偽 marks a Zhou-refused Southern Tang title, and 達 is the brother’s name, not a usurper. Replacing “usurper Prince of Qi Da” with “unrecognized Prince of Qi, Da” restores that sense and separates title from name.

In 歷試之績，並在隱帝朝內, the trials belong to Taizu, whose deeds the memorial seeks to complete; ambiguous “his” wrongly allows reading Emperor Yin as the subject. Naming Taizu matches the Chinese and the idiomatic.
